description.value: Pedder Bay Café is the Coffee House of Pedder Bay RV Resort & Marina, situated on a working marina roughly 40 minutes west of downtown Victoria. It serves locally roasted espresso drinks, baked goods, soups, and sandwiches alongside a fully licensed beer, wine, and cider selection — all available on an outdoor patio overlooking the bay. An attached General Store stocks fishing gear, ice cream, snacks, and RV supplies, making it a convenient all-in-one stop for cyclists riding the southern tip of Vancouver Island.

address.value: 925 Pedder Bay Drive, Victoria, BC V9C 4H1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pedder Bay Café is an active Coffee House within the Pedder Bay RV Resort & Marina, serving coffee, baked goods (with explicitly stated gluten-free options), soups, sandwiches, and licensed alcohol on an outdoor patio. Address (925 Pedder Bay Drive, Victoria, BC V9C 4H1) and phone (250-478-1771) are confirmed from the website, as OSM carried neither. No bike-specific amenities appear in either the website content or OSM tags; washrooms are confirmed by OSM tags (toilets=yes, toilets:wheelchair=yes) and not contradicted by the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Pedder Bay Café' differs slightly from the website's 'Coffee House' / 'General Store and Coffee House' branding — same location and function, but OSM name may not reflect current signage.
OSM community is listed as Sooke but the mailing address and resort description point to Victoria (Metchosin/West Shore area); community tag may be imprecise.
OSM carried no phone or address; both were sourced solely from the website and could not be cross-validated against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating café and general store within a marina resort, well-suited as a rest stop for touring cyclists on the Sooke/West Shore corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The café is part of the broader Pedder Bay RV Resort & Marina operated by Oak Bay Marine Group. The outdoor patio and licensed service may appeal to cyclists looking for a scenic break with a beer or cider after a long ride.
